Odoo 18 Certified

OM Master Periode

Enterprise Period & Calendar Management inspired by Odoo Fiscal Years with multi-company, multi-timezone automation.

Multi-Company Chart.js Analytics Fully Automated

Seamless Period & Calendar Control

OM Master Periode offers a centralized engine for managing custom operational periods. Generate, open, close, and archive fiscal periods automatically without manual server intervention.

  • Custom Start/End Calendar Rule (Jan 1 - Dec 31 strictly)
  • Automatic state transition (Draft → Open → Closed → Archived)
  • Visual period distribution & analytics preview
Annual Period Breakdown
Weekly
YYWww (52/year)
Monthly
YYMmm (12/year)
Quarterly
YYQ1 - YYQ4
Yearly
YYYY (Fiscal)

Automated Workflows

Daily crons evaluate active dates to open running periods and close/archive past dates without human error.

Strict Integrity & Security

SQL constraints prevent date overlaps, while read-only UI controls protect audit history across all user levels.

Multi-Timezone Support

Configurable per-company timezones in res.company ensure accurate period roll-over worldwide.
